title: streptanthus glandulosus var. albidus
intro: Streptanthus glandulosus var. albidus, commonly known as White Tower Monkey Flower, is a flowering plant species within the family Brassicaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to support immune function and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Streptanthus glandulosus var. albidus are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as glycosides and flavonoids, which have been shown to have antimicrobial and antioxidant effects. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
